    Ported from TauCeti (TauCeti.CategoryTheory.Exact.Opposite, commit 580b6f9d5, Apache 2.0).

    Opposite exact structures #

    Every exact structure on an additive category induces an exact structure on the opposite category. Its conflations are the opposites of the original conflations, so its inflations are the opposites of the original deflations and its deflations are the opposites of the original inflations.

    This file develops the self-duality of the intrinsic Quillen axioms. Identity and composition exchange their inflation and deflation forms, while pullbacks of deflations become pushouts of inflations and conversely.

    Main definitions #

    • LargeIndecomposable.Foundations.ConflationClass.op: the opposite of a conflation class.
    • LargeIndecomposable.Foundations.ExactStructure.op: the opposite of an exact structure.

    Main results #

    • LargeIndecomposable.Foundations.ConflationClass.op_inflations and LargeIndecomposable.Foundations.ConflationClass.op_deflations identify the two morphism properties under duality.
    • LargeIndecomposable.Foundations.ExactStructure.op_conflation_op_iff identifies the opposite conflations coming from an original short complex.
    • LargeIndecomposable.Foundations.ExactStructure.op_isInflation_iff and LargeIndecomposable.Foundations.ExactStructure.op_isDeflation_iff exchange inflations and deflations.

    References #

    • Theo Bühler, Exact categories, Expositiones Mathematicae 28 (2010), 1--69, https://arxiv.org/abs/0811.1480. Remarks 2.2--2.8 explain the self-duality of the exact category axioms.
